description: Canonical reference with Plain-English descriptions, Pre-Upgrade Baseline (Col 1), 2026-11-05 Day-1 Checkpoint (Col 2), 2026-11-06 Day-2 Morning (Col 3), and 2026-11-12 Day-7 Live (Col 4) for SenseCAP Solar Node P1-Pro Unleashed.

metrics.english_meaning: The software running on the rooftop repeater and the physical antenna attached to it.
metrics.col2_checkpoint_2026_11_05: Unleashed v1.18.0 + MikroTik 6.5 dBi fiberglass antenna
metrics.col3_day2_2026_11_06: Unleashed v1.18.0 + MikroTik 6.5 dBi fiberglass antenna
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: Unleashed v1.18.0 + MikroTik 6.5 dBi fiberglass antenna

metrics.english_meaning: The regional tag attached to outgoing broadcasts so regional repeaters forward them.
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: eu-region (* F / eu-region^ F / eu-sub1 F / eu-metro F)

metrics.english_meaning: How long the repeater has been running continuously without rebooting or crashing.
How full the lithium battery is (4,200 mV = 100% full, 3,150 mV = empty cutoff). EMA is smoothed to ignore brief radio spikes; raw is the instant reading.
metrics.col2_checkpoint_2026_11_05: 4,063 mV smoothed / 4,065 mV instant (+5 mV gained from afternoon sun)
metrics.col3_day2_2026_11_06: 4,059 mV smoothed / 4,061 mV instant (-4 mV over 15.4h freezing night)
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: 4,041 mV smoothed / 4,040 mV instant (-22 mV total over 7 days = -3.2 mV/day)

metrics.english_meaning: The lowest and highest voltage seen across 16 rapid measurements. A tight gap (under 20 mV) means a clean, noise-free battery sensor.
metrics.col2_checkpoint_2026_11_05: 4,060 to 4,068 mV (8 mV spread across 16 readings)
metrics.col3_day2_2026_11_06: 4,057 to 4,066 mV (9 mV spread across 16 readings)
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: 4,031 to 4,047 mV (16 mV spread across 16 readings)

metrics.english_meaning: How many microseconds the chip spends awake measuring the battery. Faster = less radio blind time and lower battery drain.
metrics.col2_checkpoint_2026_11_05: 4,883 us for 16 readings (305 us per reading — 164x faster)
metrics.col3_day2_2026_11_06: 5,860 us for 16 readings (366 us per reading — 136x faster)
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: 5,860 us for 16 readings (366 us per reading — 136x faster)

metrics.english_meaning: Current temperature inside the rooftop chip, and the temperature where the battery sensor last auto-calibrated itself (recalibrates every 10°C change so winter frost doesn't fake a low-battery reading).
The emergency voltage where the repeater shuts down to protect the battery from permanent damage.
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: 3,150 mV (strk=0 — zero low-voltage strikes in 7 days)

metrics.english_meaning: Whether external 5V USB/strong solar power is currently pushing energy in (1 = charging/external power, 0 = running on battery / MPPT trickle).
metrics.col2_checkpoint_2026_11_05: 0 (Running on internal battery at dusk, 16:56 CET)
metrics.col3_day2_2026_11_06: 0 (Running on internal battery at dawn, 08:19 CET)
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: 0 (Solar trickle balancing load via MPPT at 11:11 CET)

metrics.english_meaning: Confirming the chip's high-efficiency power converter is ON (dcdc=1) and the unused memory chip (qspi=0x2) and unused GPS chip (gps=0x2) are completely powered off to save ~1.15 mA of battery.

metrics.metric: Radio Booster & Transmitter Health (rxg / clmp / ocp / err)
metrics.english_meaning: Internal radio settings: rxg=0x96 means maximum receive sensitivity (+3 dB boost); clmp=0xFE & ocp=0x38 mean full +22 dBm transmit power protection is active; err=0x0000 means zero hardware faults.

metrics.metric: Background Radio Noise (Quiet RSSI / Noise Floor)
metrics.english_meaning: How quiet the airwaves are when nobody is talking (more negative is better). -117 dBm is near total silence, allowing faint signals from 150+ km away to be heard.

metrics.metric: Signal Clarity & Strength to Handheld (Last SNR / Last RSSI)
metrics.english_meaning: How clearly (SNR, higher positive is better; above +10 dB is maximum clarity) and how loudly (RSSI, closer to 0 is stronger) the rooftop repeater hears the handheld.
Other rooftop repeaters the mast hears directly in a single hop without needing any middleman.
metrics.col2_checkpoint_2026_11_05: 0 direct repeater adverts logged yet (4.5h window)
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: 3 direct neighbors: <peer-1> (-10.75 dB), <peer-2> (-11.0 dB), <peer-3> (7.9 km, -11.0 dB)

metrics.english_meaning: How many mesh messages and node announcements the repeater has successfully heard from the air (Flood = regional broadcasts, Direct = targeted point-to-point messages).

metrics.metric: Packets Relayed / Sent (TX Total & Hourly Rate)
metrics.english_meaning: How many messages the repeater has boosted and forwarded across the mesh to help other nodes talk.
Total seconds the radio spent actively transmitting (TX) and receiving (RX) since boot.
Packets that failed to transmit due to radio or hardware errors. Should always be 0.
Percentage of faint/colliding distant radio signals that arrived too weak or garbled to decode. Lower means cleaner reception.
metrics.col4_day7_2026_11_12: 35.04% (9,133 corrupted out of 26,061 — 17% lower error rate vs stock)

metrics.metric: Total Discovered Nodes on Handheld (M9 Contacts)
metrics.english_meaning: Total unique repeaters, chat rooms, and users the handheld has discovered through the rooftop repeater.
How many discovered repeaters/rooms are more than 50 km and 100 km away, and the farthest node reached.
metrics.col1_baseline: 6 nodes >50 km | 5 nodes >100 km | Max: 190.5 km
metrics.col2_checkpoint_2026_11_05: 19 nodes >50 km (3.2x) | 13 nodes >100 km (2.6x) | Max: 192.9 km
metrics.col3_day2_2026_11_06: 28 nodes >50 km (4.7x) | 19 nodes >100 km (3.8x) | Max: 354.7 km
